purpose: Teach: 燃やし/とうてい/しかるべき/思い通り/のべ/いちおう/かならず/みごと

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが庭で焚き火を燃やしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to keep a fire burning in the garden.
lines.style: Quiet, distant voice. Soft onset. Slow, measured pace — each phrase carries weight without hurrying. Looking back across decades. A small wonder underneath the restraint.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お疲れの時はとうていお出かけになれなかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and he couldn't get out much when he was tired, could he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing half-smile in the voice. Gentle agreement. She's meeting him in memory, not correcting him. Soft landing on the final term of endearment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが、しかるべき判断をされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father always made the right decisions.
lines.style: Slower still. Quiet conviction. Each word deliberate, like laying down something precious. No rush to the end. A gentle settling in the tone.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご自身の思い通りに家を建てられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and he built the house just the way he wanted it, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Affectionate, present. She's there with him in these moments, affirming without sentimentality. Light, steady tone. The comfort of being understood without explanation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがのべ百年の家系を語られたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father used to speak about our family line stretching back a hundred years.
lines.style: Voice carries both humility and pride. Pause-heavy. The word 'hundred' lands with quiet significance. Long breath before the end, letting the weight settle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、いちおう毎日散歩されてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and he went for his walk almost every day, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact. She's noting the small constancies that made a life. No drama — just the steady tone of someone who watched these habits day after day.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんはかならず約束を守られたぞ
lines.en: Gran, your father always kept his promises. Always.
lines.style: Firm but tender. The word 'always' carries quiet emphasis — not angry, but certain. A lifetime of trust crystallized into a single declaration. Slight hold at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、書道をみごとにお書きになってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and he had such a beautiful hand with calligraphy, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Admiring, soft. She's remembering something tangible — his brush, his discipline, his artistry. Gentle warmth. The final phrase trails with affection, drawing close.
